title: fold-ON DCE deleted an orphaned `41n & p`; the script accepted multi-byte p that OP_AND must abort on

provenance.note: Nightly 'Fuzzer nightly' run 42154150919 (job 127684172795), execute oracle, seed 1351961626, FuzzContract94.method2 with args (false, -49253n, true). Minimised by hand to the three statements that matter: `41n & param84` bound to a let that is then overwritten by a constant, and an assert the folder decides. Pre-fix fold-ON bytes were 5177 (OP_1 OP_NIP) in all 7 tiers.

rationale: OP_AND requires equal-length operands. 41 encodes to one byte and -49253 to three, so the source (the ANF interpreter) and the fold-OFF script both abort on `41n & p`: the spend is invalid. Pre-fix, the fold-ON N-138 prune deleted the AND once folding `m === 5n` to true orphaned it, because DCE treated every bin_op as pure, and the deployed script accepted every p. reject/reject is the correct verdict; requiredOpcodes [OP_AND] fails the entry if the AND is ever deleted again.
